build_service_pipeline: build a server-side interceptor pipeline by calling service_pipeline with a list of interceptors
build_intercept_channel: build an intercepted gRPC channel by wrapping a channel with client interceptors via intercept_channel
create_unary_unary_interceptor: create a UnaryUnaryMultiCallable that intercepts unary-unary RPC calls through a client interceptor
create_unary_stream_interceptor: create a UnaryStreamMultiCallable that intercepts unary-stream RPC calls through a client interceptor
create_stream_stream_interceptor: create a StreamStreamMultiCallable that intercepts bidirectional streaming RPC calls through a client interceptor
